name: apple-calendar
description: Read and create Apple Calendar events and reminders from Claude.
long_description: A small local MCP server built on EventKit. Lists calendars, events, reminder lists and open reminders, and creates events and reminders with location, notes, priority and recurrence. macOS only; the first use asks for calendar and reminders access.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List events in a time range.

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.description: List open reminders, sorted by due date.
